question: RM 与 RT 在 ICF 内爆不同阶段的相对重要性,正确的说法是?

options.A: RM 在冲击通过界面(如首次冲击、反弹冲击)时注入扰动种子;RT 在持续加速/减速阶段放大扰动
options.B: RM 只在减速阶段重要
options.C: RT 只在加速阶段重要
options.D: 两者在所有阶段同等重要

metadata.source: ICF 内爆 RT/RM 阶段论(公开综述)
metadata.notes: 阶段划分是分析内爆不稳定性的基础

question_en: What is the correct statement about the relative importance of RM and RT at different stages of ICF implosion?

options_en.A: RM 在冲击通过界面(如首次冲击、反弹冲击)时注入扰动种子;RT 在持续加速/减速阶段放大扰动
options_en.B: RM is only important in the deceleration phase.
options_en.C: RT is only important during the acceleration phase.
options_en.D: Both are equally important at all stages.

question: 关于 ICF 中子谱诊断,正确的有(多选):

options.A: 14.1 MeV 主中子的谱形(多普勒展宽)可反推燃料离子温度
options.B: 下降散射中子(约 10-12 MeV)与主中子之比(DSR)测量燃料 ρR
options.C: 中子飞行时间(nTOF)谱仪利用不同能量中子的到达时间差分辨能谱
options.D: 中子谱完全不能用于内爆对称性诊断

metadata.source: ICF 中子诊断公开综述
metadata.notes: D 错:多方向 nTOF 可诊断对称性

evidence.cross_source: 中子诊断综述公开论文

question_en: Regarding ICF neutron spectrum diagnostics, which of the following are correct? (Multiple correct answers):

options_en.A: The spectral shape (Doppler broadening) of 14.1 MeV primary neutrons can be used to infer the fuel ion temperature.
options_en.B: 下降散射中子(约 10-12 MeV)与主中子之比(DSR)测量燃料 ρR
options_en.C: The neutron time-of-flight (nTOF) spectrometer resolves the energy spectrum by using the arrival time difference of neutrons with different energies.
options_en.D: Neutron spectra cannot be used for implosion symmetry diagnostics at all.

question: 关于 X 射线分幅相机(XRFC)在 ICF 中的作用,正确的是?

options.A: 以数十 ps 时间分辨记录内爆靶丸 X 光图像演化,用于测量内爆轨迹、对称性与停滞形态

metadata.source: ICF X 光诊断公开资料

question_en: Regarding the role of the X-ray framing camera (XRFC) in ICF, which of the following is correct?

options_en.A: The evolution of X-ray images of imploding capsules is recorded with tens of ps time resolution to measure implosion trajectory, symmetry and stagnation morphology.
options_en.B: Only static photos can be taken.
options_en.D: The temporal resolution is on the millisecond scale.

question: 关于 VISAR(任意反射面速度干涉仪)在冲击波实验中的测量原理,正确的是?

options.A: 利用运动反射面的多普勒频移使干涉条纹移动,条纹位移与反射面速度成正比,从而测量冲击/自由面速度历史

metadata.source: VISAR 诊断原理(公开教科书)
metadata.notes: 多普勒+干涉是速度诊断标准手段

question_en: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the measurement principle of VISAR (Velocity Interferometer System for Any Reflector) in shock wave experiments?

options_en.A: 利用运动反射面的多普勒频移使干涉条纹移动,条纹位移与反射面速度成正比,从而测量冲击/自由面速度历史
options_en.D: Only static displacement can be measured

question: 关于 ICF 靶丸烧蚀层材料选择(CH、Be、HDC/金刚石),正确的有(多选):

options.A: HDC 密度高、烧蚀压大,可实现更高内爆速度,但制备难
options.B: Be 对 X 光不透明度高可屏蔽预热,且力学性能好
options.C: CH(塑料)最早使用、制备成熟,但密度低
options.D: 材料选择与内爆性能无关

metadata.source: 烧蚀层材料比较(公开综述)

evidence.cross_source: 靶丸材料综述公开论文

question_en: Regarding the selection of ablator materials for ICF target capsules (CH, Be, HDC/diamond), which of the following are correct? (Choose all that apply)

options_en.A: HDC has high density and high ablation pressure, enabling a higher implosion velocity, but it is difficult to fabricate.
options_en.B: Be has high opacity to X-rays, which can shield preheat, and good mechanical properties.
options_en.C: CH(塑料)最早使用、制备成熟,但密度低
options_en.D: Material selection is independent of implosion performance

question: 间接驱动黑腔上激光入射孔(LEH)的设计权衡是?

options.A: LEH 越大激光耦合越容易但 X 光泄漏损失越大;需在耦合效率与 X 光约束之间折中
options.C: LEH 越小越好,无耦合问题

metadata.source: 黑腔 LEH 设计(公开教科书)
metadata.notes: 耦合-约束权衡是黑腔设计核心

question_en: What are the design trade-offs of the laser entrance hole (LEH) on indirect-drive hohlraums?

options_en.A: The larger the LEH, the easier the laser coupling, but the greater the X-ray leakage loss; a trade-off between coupling efficiency and X-ray confinement is required.
options_en.C: The smaller the LEH, the better, and there is no coupling problem.
options_en.D: LEH is independent of energy balance

question: 在 LTE 与非 LTE(non-LTE)不透明度计算的适用性上,正确的是?

options.A: 高密度(碰撞主导)时 LTE 近似较好;低密度晕区/快速变化区需 non-LTE 速率方程模型
options.B: LTE 在所有 ICF 区域都精确成立
options.D: LTE 与 non-LTE 结果总相同

metadata.source: LTE/non-LTE 适用性(公开教科书)
metadata.notes: 密度与时间尺度决定模型选择

question_en: Which of the following is correct regarding the applicability of LTE and non-LTE opacity calculations?

options_en.A: The LTE approximation works well under high-density (collision-dominated) conditions; non-LTE rate equation models are required for low-density halo regions and rapidly varying regions.
options_en.B: LTE holds exactly in all ICF regions
options_en.D: The results of LTE and non-LTE are always the same.

question: 关于辐射热波(Marshak 波)与流体激波在 ICF 靶中的相互作用,正确的有(多选):

options.A: 辐射热波可先于激波加热材料,改变其初始状态(预热)
options.B: 预热会提高燃料熵,使后续压缩效率下降
options.C: 辐射热波与激波完全独立,互不影响
options.D: 控制预热是间接驱动靶设计的核心问题之一

metadata.source: 辐射热波-激波耦合(公开教科书)
metadata.notes: C 错:两者通过能量方程耦合

evidence.cross_source: Drake HEDP 辐射热波章节

question_en: Regarding the interaction between radiative heat wave (Marshak wave) and hydrodynamic shock wave in ICF targets, which of the following are correct? (Select all that apply):

options_en.A: Radiation heat waves can heat the material ahead of the shock wave and modify its initial state (preheat).
options_en.B: Preheating increases the fuel entropy, thereby reducing the subsequent compression efficiency.
options_en.C: Radiative heat waves and shock waves are completely independent and do not affect each other.
options_en.D: Controlling preheat is one of the core problems in indirect-drive target design

question: 关于 ICF 中的能量输运机制,正确的有(多选):

options.A: 电子热传导在烧蚀晕区起关键作用,需用通量限制(flux limiter)处理非局域效应
options.B: 辐射输运在高 Z 壁材料中以多群扩散近似为主
options.C: 热传导在所有区域都是局域线性的
options.D: 激光能量沉积主要通过逆韧致吸收

metadata.source: ICF 能量输运机制(公开教科书)
metadata.notes: C 错:晕区热流高度非局域

question_en: Regarding the energy transport mechanisms in ICF, which of the following are correct? (Choose all that apply)

options_en.A: 电子热传导在烧蚀晕区起关键作用,需用通量限制(flux limiter)处理非局域效应
options_en.B: Radiation transport in high-Z wall materials is dominated by the multi-group diffusion approximation.
options_en.C: Thermal conduction is locally linear in all regions.
options_en.D: Laser energy deposition occurs mainly through inverse bremsstrahlung absorption.

question: 关于临界密度面在 ICF 中的物理意义,正确的有(多选):

options.A: 激光只能传播到临界密度面附近,能量沉积主要发生在次临界晕区
options.B: 临界密度由激光波长决定(波长越短,临界密度越高)
options.C: 四分之一临界密度面是 TPD/SRS 的关键位置
options.D: 超过临界密度后激光完全不被吸收

metadata.source: 临界密度物理(公开教科书)
metadata.notes: D 错:倏逝波仍有部分耦合

question_en: Regarding the physical significance of the critical density surface in ICF, which of the following statements are correct? (Select all that apply)

options_en.A: The laser can only propagate up to the vicinity of the critical density surface, and energy deposition mainly occurs in the subcritical halo region.
options_en.B: The critical density is determined by the laser wavelength (the shorter the wavelength, the higher the critical density).
options_en.C: The quarter-critical density surface is a key location for TPD/SRS.
options_en.D: When the density exceeds the critical density, the laser is completely unabsorbed.

question: 关于压致电离(pressure ionization)在高密度等离子体中的意义,正确的是?

options.A: 高密度下粒子间相互作用使连续谱下移、束缚态消失,电离度高于孤立原子 Saha 预测,是稠密 ICF 等离子体 EOS 的关键修正
options.B: 压致电离只发生在真空中
options.C: 压致电离使电离度降低

metadata.source: 压致电离/连续谱下降(公开教科书)
metadata.notes: 致密等离子体的核心效应

evidence.cross_source: 稠密等离子体教科书章节

question_en: Which of the following is correct regarding the significance of pressure ionization in high-density plasmas?

options_en.A: 高密度下粒子间相互作用使连续谱下移、束缚态消失,电离度高于孤立原子 Saha 预测,是稠密 ICF 等离子体 EOS 的关键修正
options_en.B: Pressure ionization only occurs in vacuum.
options_en.C: Pressure ionization reduces the degree of ionization.
options_en.D: Pressure ionization is independent of density

question: 关于 ICF 中子产额测量的绝对定标,正确的有(多选):

options.A: 需要已知效率的探测器(如活化样品、塑料闪烁体)与几何因子
options.B: 绝对产额误差直接影响靶增益的宣称
options.C: 只需相对计数即可得到增益
options.D: 定标与探测器位置无关

metadata.source: 中子产额定标(公开诊断资料)
metadata.notes: 绝对定标是增益宣称的基础

evidence.cross_source: 中子诊断定标公开资料

question_en: Regarding the absolute calibration of ICF neutron yield measurement, which of the following are correct? (Select all that apply)

options_en.A: Detectors with known efficiency (e.g., activation samples, plastic scintillators) and geometric factor are required.
options_en.B: The absolute yield error directly affects the claim of target gain.
options_en.C: Only relative counting is required to obtain the gain.
options_en.D: The calibration is independent of the detector position.

question: 关于激光束平滑技术(RPP、SSD、PSD、CPP)的作用,正确的有(多选):

options.A: 随机相位板(RPP)把束斑打散为小散斑,降低大尺度不均匀性
options.B: 光谱色散平滑(SSD)使散斑随时间快速变化,抑制成丝/不稳定性增长
options.C: 偏振平滑(PSD/CPP)减少散斑间相干,进一步抑制 SBS
options.D: 平滑技术会显著降低激光总能量

metadata.source: 激光束平滑技术(公开教科书;OMEGA/NIF 公开资料)
metadata.notes: D 错:平滑主要改变空间-时间相干,不显著损失能量

question_en: Regarding the effects of laser beam smoothing techniques (RPP, SSD, PSD, CPP), which of the following are correct? (Multi-select):

options_en.A: Random phase plate (RPP) breaks up the beam spot into small speckles and reduces large-scale non-uniformity.
options_en.B: Smoothing by Spectral Dispersion (SSD) induces rapid temporal variation of speckles and suppresses the growth of filamentation/instability.
options_en.C: Polarization smoothing (PSD/CPP) reduces inter-speckle coherence and further suppresses SBS.
options_en.D: Smoothing techniques can significantly reduce the total laser energy.
